legend: After a hard-working week Polycarp prefers to have fun. Polycarp's favorite entertainment is drawing snakes. He takes a rectangular checkered sheet of paper of size n×m$$$n \times m$$$ (where n$$$n$$$ is the number of rows, m$$$m$$$ is the number of columns) and starts to draw snakes in cells.

Polycarp draws snakes with lowercase Latin letters. He always draws the first snake with the symbol 'a', the second snake with the symbol 'b', the third snake with the symbol 'c' and so on. All snakes have their own unique symbol. There are only 26$$$26$$$ letters in the Latin alphabet, Polycarp is very tired and he doesn't want to invent new symbols, so the total number of drawn snakes doesn't exceed 26$$$26$$$.

Since by the end of the week Polycarp is very tired, he draws snakes as straight lines without bends. So each snake is positioned either vertically or horizontally. Width of any snake equals 1$$$1$$$, i.e. each snake has size either 1×l$$$1 \times l$$$ or l×1$$$l \times 1$$$, where l$$$l$$$ is snake's length. Note that snakes can't bend.
When Polycarp draws a new snake, he can use already occupied cells for drawing the snake. In this situation, he draws the snake "over the top" and overwrites the previous value in the cell.

Recently when Polycarp was at work he found a checkered sheet of paper with Latin letters. He wants to know if it is possible to get this sheet of paper from an empty sheet by drawing some snakes according to the rules described above. If it is possible, he is interested in a way to draw snakes.
input: The first line of the input contains one integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤105$$$1 \le t \le 10^5$$$) — the number of test cases to solve. Then t$$$t$$$ test cases follow.
The first line of the test case description contains two integers n$$$n$$$, m$$$m$$$ (1≤n,m≤2000$$$1 \le n,m \le 2000$$$) — length and width of the checkered sheet of paper respectively.

Next n$$$n$$$ lines of test case description contain m$$$m$$$ symbols, which are responsible for the content of the corresponding cell on the sheet. It can be either lowercase Latin letter or symbol dot ('.'), which stands for an empty cell.
It is guaranteed that the total area of all sheets in one test doesn't exceed 4⋅106$$$4\cdot10^6$$$.
output: Print the answer for each test case in the input.
In the first line of the output for a test case print YES if it is possible to draw snakes, so that you can get a sheet of paper from the input. If it is impossible, print NO.

If the answer to this question is positive, then print the way to draw snakes in the following format. In the next line print one integer k$$$k$$$ (0≤k≤26$$$0 \le k \le 26$$$) — number of snakes. Then print k$$$k$$$ lines, in each line print four integers r1,i$$$r_{1,i}$$$, c1,i$$$c_{1,i}$$$, r2,i$$$r_{2,i}$$$ and c2,i$$$c_{2,i}$$$ — coordinates of extreme cells for the i$$$i$$$-th snake (1≤r1,i,r2,i≤n$$$1 \le r_{1,i}, r_{2,i} \le n$$$, 1≤c1,i,c2,i≤m$$$1 \le c_{1,i}, c_{2,i} \le m$$$). Snakes should be printed in order of their drawing. If there are multiple solutions, you are allowed to print any of them.
Note that Polycarp starts drawing of snakes with an empty sheet of paper.

legend.ai: 经过一周的辛勤工作后，Polycarp 喜欢找点乐子。Polycarp 最喜欢的娱乐活动是画蛇。他拿出一张大小为 n×m$$$n \times m$$$ 的矩形方格纸(其中 n$$$n$$$ 是行数，m$$$m$$$ 是列数)，然后开始在格子中画蛇。
Polycarp 使用小写拉丁字母来画蛇。他总是用符号 'a' 画第一条蛇，用符号 'b' 画第二条蛇，用符号 'c' 画第三条蛇，以此类推。每条蛇都有自己唯一的符号。拉丁字母表中只有 26$$$26$$$ 个字母，而 Polycarp 非常疲惫，不想发明新的符号，因此画出的蛇的总数不超过 26$$$26$$$。
由于一周结束时 Polycarp 非常疲惫，他把蛇画成不弯曲的直线。因此，每条蛇要么竖直放置，要么水平放置。任意蛇的宽度均为 1$$$1$$$，也就是说，每条蛇的大小要么是 1×l$$$1 \times l$$$，要么是 l×1$$$l \times 1$$$，其中 l$$$l$$$ 是蛇的长度。注意，蛇不能弯曲。
当 Polycarp 画一条新蛇时，可以使用已经被占用的格子来画蛇。在这种情况下，他会将蛇“画在上面”，覆盖格子中之前的内容。
最近，Polycarp 工作时发现了一张写有拉丁字母的方格纸。他想知道，是否可以按照上述规则，通过绘制若干条蛇，从一张空白纸得到这张纸。如果可以，他希望知道一种绘制蛇的方法。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤105$$$1 \le t \le 10^5$$$)——需要解决的测试用例数量。随后给出 t$$$t$$$ 个测试用例。
测试用例描述的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$、m$$$m$$$(1≤n,m≤2000$$$1 \le n,m \le 2000$$$)——方格纸的长度和宽度，分别为 n 和 m。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行测试用例描述中包含 m$$$m$$$ 个符号，它们表示方格纸上对应单元格的内容。该符号可以是小写拉丁字母，也可以是点号('.')，表示空单元格。
保证一次测试中所有方格纸的总面积不超过 4⋅106$$$4\cdot10^6$$$。

output.ai: 对于输入中的每个测试用例，输出其答案。
对于一个测试用例，如果可以绘制蛇，使得能够从输入中得到一张纸，则在输出的第一行输出 YES。否则，输出 NO。

如果答案为肯定，则按照以下格式输出绘制蛇的方法。在下一行输出一个整数 k$$$k$$$(0≤k≤26$$$0 \le k \le 26$$$)——蛇的数量。接下来输出 k$$$k$$$ 行，每行输出四个整数 r1,i$$$r_{1,i}$$$、c1,i$$$c_{1,i}$$$、r2,i$$$r_{2,i}$$$ 和 c2,i$$$c_{2,i}$$$——第 i$$$i$$$ 条蛇的两个端点单元格的坐标(1≤r1,i,r2,i≤n$$$1 \le r_{1,i}, r_{2,i} \le n$$$，1≤c1,i,c2,i≤m$$$1 \le c_{1,i}, c_{2,i} \le m$$$)。应按照绘制顺序输出这些蛇。如果有多种解，输出其中任意一种即可。
注意，Polycarp 开始绘制蛇时，纸张是空的。
